name: inbox.meta_done
description: What came of a reply through our own Meta app, after inbox.meta_claim: sent, or unknown (the answer was lost: it may have gone, and the person checks the account), takes the message out of the inbox; failed (Meta refused) leaves it there, with the reply kept as typed. Only a claimed reply changes. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: update brandbase.inbox_messages m set reply_status = :status, done_at = case when :status = 'failed' then null else :now::timestamptz end where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand and m.reply_status = 'queued' returning jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'replyStatus', m.reply_status, 'doneAt', brandbase.iso(m.done_at)) as result
